title.narrative: Distribution of school bags for Syrian students

description.narrative: The project aims to provide educational support and enrollment in schools for the children of the most needy Syrian families in the Kingdom of Jordan. Providing educational support and enrollment in schools for 29,881 children of the Hashemite Syrian families.
The project aims to provide educational support and school enrollment of the children of the most needy Syrian families in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.

The project provides educational support and enrollment in schools for children of poor Syrian families in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan in order to ensure the continuity of the educational process and contribute to motivating children to continue learning and reduce the causes leading to school dropout.
